description: Clint-landscapevideo.mp4There is a FAQ up on this website that explains this is more detail, and I also welcome people to reach out to me with questions. The short version is that I am very sorry I made a mistake in how I accepted $5 Clean Elections donations from 12 people. I filled out the paperwork when I should have each of them do it themselves. The donations were genuine contributions from real people. I learned from the mistake, and I am genuinely sorry that it happened.
